result.prior_version_note: Before Measure BB (passed in the November 2024 election), the AGA was set by the Rent Ordinance's CPI formula with no 5% maximum. That formula is 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase, approved by voters in November 2004 (BMC § 13.76.110A). Measure BB added the 5% cap as a 'NEW' change. The documents do not say when the AGA rent-ceiling limit first applied, or what the 2025 AGA amount was.
